---
name: Feature request
about: Describe a workload or contract that the current interface does not meet.
---

## Use case

Describe the concrete workload, source revision, existing API used and expected outcome. Explain the limitation and any current workaround.

## Proposed contract

Describe ownership, lifetime, failure behavior, threading and backend capabilities. Backend registration and a stable plugin ABI are not provided today; new backend or dependency proposals require an explicit maintenance and compatibility decision.

## Validation

Give a small example and measurable acceptance criteria. Identify necessary platform, installed-consumer and performance evidence, including work that has not yet been done. Do not treat benchmark rankings as proof that one design is universally best.
